title: Venezuelan Bowl with Lazy Umeboshi Meat
description: A twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine, this recipe combines the flavors of la parilla with the tanginess of umeboshi. Perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and black pepper.
Grill the pork chops for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked to a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork chops rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, mix together the Venezuelan-Style Umeboshi Sauce ingredients in a bowl.
Add the sliced pork chops to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Divide the mixed greens among four bowls.
Top each bowl with a pork chop, a spoonful of the sauce, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Drizzle with avocado oil and serve immediately.
